aircraft_name: The Last Herk Out of Vietnam
description: C-130A-8-LM c/n 182-3126 in the FY56 C-130A block; accepted 23 Aug 1957; 314th TCW Sewart 1964-72; to the VNAF 2 Nov 1972; on 29 Apr 1975 flew 452 evacuees out of Tan Son Nhut to U-Tapao as the last C-130 out of Saigon; recovered by the USAF and flown by the ANG 185th and 105th TAS; final flight to LRAFB 28 Jun 1989; NMUSAF loan to 19 MXS; parked outside the main gate beside the Visitor Center with public parking; OSM node carries the serial; Street View Jun 2019 shows it; Baugher wrongly repeats the gate-display claim under 57-0518 (c/n 3225 which went to Mexico as XA-RYZ)
museum_name: Little Rock Air Force Base Main Gate
